checks.criterion: O endpoint de catálogo fornece os quatro planos, valores, selo, economia e paymentMocked
checks.name: test_tscheck_catalog_plans.py::test_catalog_exposes_requested_plans_and_mocked_payment
checks.evidence: GET /api/catalog/plans returned 200; asserted four plan ids/prices, Premium neon badge, R$ 238,80 savings, and paymentMocked=true.

checks.criterion: Confirmação de assinatura salva a localização no backend
checks.name: test_tscheck_subscription_persistence.py::test_subscription_confirmation_persists_unique_location
checks.evidence: POST /api/subscriptions returned 201; GET /api/subscriptions returned 200 and contained the test-created id with unique city, CEP, uppercase UF, plan and mocked status.

checks.name: test_tscheck_sensitive_payment.py::test_subscription_does_not_persist_sensitive_payment_fields
checks.evidence: POST /api/subscriptions returned 201 with debit payload; response and subsequent GET row contained no card number, expiry, CVV or CPF keys.

checks.criterion: Após a verificação documental, o botão de continuação abre o catálogo
checks.name: document-verification-opens-catalog
checks.evidence: Verification page button navigated to /front-end/catalogo/index.html and catalog heading was visible.

checks.criterion: O catálogo exibe os quatro planos solicitados
checks.name: catalog-shows-four-plans
checks.evidence: Catalog rendered Gratuito, Premium, Destaque, Premium Anual with R$ 0,00, R$ 19,90, R$ 9,90 and R$ 199,90.

checks.criterion: Premium apresenta o selo verde neon e Premium Anual explicita a economia
checks.name: catalog-highlights-premium-value
checks.evidence: Visible text included Selo neon verificado and Economize R$ 238,80 em relação a 12 mensalidades.

checks.criterion: Localização é coletada no checkout e exigida antes da confirmação
checks.name: checkout-requires-location
checks.evidence: Checkout exposed Cidade, CEP and Estado fields; confirming empty form displayed the required location message.

checks.criterion: Premium Anual oferece Pix e cartão de débito com campos demonstrativos seguros
checks.name: annual-checkout-offers-safe-debit-fields
checks.evidence: Annual checkout showed PIX and CARTÃO DE DÉBITO; debit selection exposed number, expiry, CVV and CPF fields plus warning that data will not be sent.

checks.criterion: Confirmação mostra plano escolhido e localização persistida
checks.name: subscription-confirmation-shows-plan-and-location
checks.evidence: Filled unique browser location and submitted annual plan; checkout status showed Premium Anual, MOCKADA and backend persistence message.
